summary.intent: Finish the print-once fix PR (#496), then move to pre-1.0 hardening: consistent JSON error envelope (#177), tests for untested spec criteria (#178), and an audit of 1.0 stability promises including JSON field naming.
summary.outcome: PR #496 was opened, given an improved description, and merged along with #495. Five parallel agents were launched (error-envelope, spec-test-gaps, v1-stability-audit, json-naming-inventory, camel-case-fields); none had reported final results by the end of the transcript, and only cli_tests.rs was modified.

repo: Discovery notes (ignored private root, crate with no version) were printed up to three times by `callisto init` because the workspace is loaded multiple times; the fix is a process-wide dedup helper `note_once` using a static OnceLock<Mutex<BTreeSet>>, used in ignore_walk.rs and walk.rs.
The release-preview note is a different kind of note in the CLI crate and was intentionally left out of the print-once fix.

Internally-tagged serde enums need both `rename_all` (for discriminants) and `rename_all_fields` (for variant fields) set to camelCase; BumpReason::Cascade (report.rs) and ProviderEvidenceV1 variants (release_observation.rs, part of versioned ReleaseReceiptV1) have snake_case fields.
`short_sha` in crates/callisto-graph/src/release_preview.rs is snake_case in a shipped preview file; changing it is a shipped-format decision.
Failing `release plan` / `release-pr` subcommands emit a different `command` key and omit `dryRun` in JSON errors (trail #177).
docs/stability.md defines a Stable table of 1.0 promises (flags, exit codes 0/1/2, schemaVersion, unknown config keys, error-code reuse, tags/action inputs).

code.finding: BumpReason::Cascade has snake_case fields dep_kind and dependency_to due to missing rename_all_fields (internal report type).
ProviderEvidenceV1 variants have snake_case fields peeled_commit, tag_name, byte_length; these are in versioned receipt JSON so fixing is a format change.
Area containing the short_sha field that neither the agent inventory nor the manual scan detected.

friction: Inventory agent's result was incomplete (5 hits, missed short_sha) and the manual scan found a sixth hit but also missed short_sha, forcing a third approach.
Overlapping scope risk among five parallel agents touching report types.
CI could not be run locally, so verification relied on local checks outside the sandbox.
open_items: Decide whether to change `short_sha` to camelCase in the shipped preview file (format decision).
